main_text.p: alibi meminit idem Paulus. Dum Thes-salonicenses, contribulium rabie,& motâ in ipsos persecutióne, imitatores factos dicit Ecclesiarum quæ sunt in Judæâ, 1. Thess. 11.14. Atque ita, Epistola ad He-bræos, ad Palæstinas tantùm data fuerit Ecclesias, vel serpserit eadem persecutio postmodùm latiùs,ad Judæos quaquaver-sùm. Vidit & hoc ipsum Theodoretus, qui Argumento in Epist. ad Hebræos, de iisdem afflictionibus, sermonem esse docet, citato loco illo ad Thessalonicenses. Idem, alij ex Interpretibus. Et quanquam sola hæc fortè circumstantia non sufficeret, at alijs juncta, contemnendam minimè esse censemus. Imprimis si Paulinum morem perpendimus, quo & afflictiones singulis suas revocare in memoriam solet, & suavissimo solatiorum lenire balsamo.
V. Tertia circumstantia est, Authoris illa suæ συνειδήσεως [?] καὶ ἀναφο-φῆς [?], sanctæ quidem & inculpatæ,

page.notes: The Greek words "συνειδήσεως" and "ἀναφορᾶς" (broken as "ἀναφο-" / "φῆς" with tilde) are doubtful at this scan resolution; the Greek is marked [?]. The page number "309" and the catchword "recor-" are also read from a low-resolution scan. The Latin text reads clearly otherwise.
